//: Race-tile camera framing for the design POC (P1-U05.2, R98). The TV mock (poc/tv/world.js) and the in-world mock (poc/world/world.js) both read it. Once the owner accepts it at G-DESIGN, these are the TUNE inputs for P1-R05. Distances are metres from the car's origin (on the ground between the axles); lookAhead is how far down the car's heading the camera aims. Distance is a setting: the host picks the default, and each player may override it for their own tile. A tile shows the host default unless that player overrode it.

distance.note: Fewer, bigger tiles can afford near; 24+ small tiles read better at mid or far (the car stays legible and the road ahead shows). The playtests pick per count; nothing here caps anything.

round0.note: The round-0 rig the owner found too close (POC1-12); kept only for before/after captures (&cam=round0).

mirror.note: Segmented first person: a bonnet-cam eye over the front of the bonnet, pitched a touch down, gives the road most of the tile and keeps a strip of bonnet so it reads as first person, and a rear-view mirror takes the strip of sky that would otherwise be wasted, looking back from above the roof so the car's own wing doesn't fill it. Rects are fractions of the tile.
